scope.implementation: Ordinary invocation allocation and retainFrom reserve physical backing plus one conservative owner allowance before allocation or ownership publication in scheduler-bound contexts
scope.rollback: Shared reservation guard refunds unpublished allocation/retention on failure or post-reservation cancellation; successful owners retain conservative charges until settlement
scope.sharing: Each ordinary retain reserves independently; later recursive graph registration reuses surviving charged owners, including task-created ordinary buffers
scope.compatibility: Unbound synchronous invocations remain outside scheduler admission; recursive source/planner admission remains gated; receiving/source usability is checked before ordinary retention

coverage: Exact and one-byte-short byte caps for allocate, allocateRecord and retainFrom
Cancellation immediately after successful reservation refunds bytes without publishing an owner or increasing backing references
Injected allocation admission failure preserves the source and publishes no ownership
Duplicate ordinary retain cannot bypass an exhausted cap
Record cleanup removes owners while keeping conservative reservations until settlement; repeated settlement does not refund twice
Graph registration does not recharge task-created ordinary dependency backing
Task-created Unicode String and numeric buffer exercise production allocation and cached-result retention under packet-only, exact-peak and one-byte-short caps in pools of one, two and four workers
Failed result observation preserves caller output; successful cached observations survive scheduler destruction
Recursive graph/node/runtime and generated callable/task/error bridge regressions plus ordinary invocation, allocation lease, worker, compiled worker, source task, recovery and record worker suites
qualification.build: Rebuilt CLI, emitter, runtime archives and selected direct tests. Added String.cpp to task-test targets for production String checks. CPU-only CMake configuration with DEVELOPER_DIR=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools; pinned Metal toolchain unavailable on this host. No Metal qualification claimed.
qualification.format: Changed C++ ranges formatted; git diff --check passes

limitations: Conservative per-invocation reservations remain until settlement even after explicit release; duplicate ordinary retains and distinct contexts may each charge the same backing
Transport-storage payload reservations and environment cap remain additional allowances
Persistent invocation-owned backing accounting does not cover allocator metadata or all temporary compiler/runtime workspace
Recursive source/planner integration and broader execution/callable/error qualification remain pending
No GPU, distributed, CUDA, public C/C++ ABI, cross-platform, full-suite or performance claim
